dialogue.tonpetty.hamon1: Tonpetty: Ensimmäiseksi, sinun pitää hengittää sisään! Hengitä syvään.
dialogue.tonpetty.hamon2: Tonpetty: Erinomaista! Nyt Kokoa voimasi.. Keskity! Löydä 'Ylikellotuksesi'!
dialogue.tonpetty.hamon3: Tonpetty: Seuraavaksi, sinun pitää Ylikellottaa itsesi, että voit tehdä sinun ensimmäisen 'Venylyönnin' ja tuhota oliot.
dialogue.tonpetty.hamon4: Tonpetty: seuraavaan koetukseen, sinun pitää surmata hirviö käyttämällä 'Venylyöntiä' ja viimeistellä työ 'Hamon-Yläkoukullasi'!
dialogue.tonpetty.hamon5: Tonpetty: Alat tottumaan Sendon voimiin.. Nyt sinun pitää oppia levittämään Sendoa. Näytä hirviöille, mitä 'Hamon-Aalto' voi aiheuttaa.
dialogue.tonpetty.hamon6: Tonpetty: Olet mestaruuden kynnyksellä.. Murskaa tuo otus 'Sendoaalto-Potkulla', ja siihen perään tömistele heidät littanaksi.
dialogue.tonpetty.master: Tonpetty: Olen nähnyt tarpeeksi. Tervetuloa meidän joukkoon.

jcraft.serverconfig.option.base_ai_level:
Default skill level given to JCraft-controlled
enemies. Higher values make them fight more
competently.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.block_breakag:
Multiplies the damage attacks do to blocks when
not hitting an entity.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.cooldown_mult:
Multiplies the length of all move cooldowns. Lower
values shorten cooldowns, higher values lengthen
them.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.cream_item_er:
When enabled, items caught in Cream's void are
erased instead of being dropped.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.damage_scalin:
The lowest the combo damage multiplier can fall
to. Each hit in a combo scales damage down toward
this floor.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.disable_comba:
When enabled, players can't start elytra flight
for a short time after taking damage.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.dummy_damage_:
Range, in blocks, within which floating damage
numbers from training dummies are shown to
players.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.enable_friend:
When enabled, players can damage each other with
JCraft attacks. Players on the same scoreboard
team are treated as allies.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.enable_move_c:
Whether Stand and ability moves have cooldowns
after use. Disable to remove all move cooldowns.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.exclusive_sta:
When enabled, each Stand can only be claimed by
one player at a time and cannot be given to or
stolen by others.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.gravity_only_:
When enabled, gravity-changing abilities only
affect players, leaving other entities unaffected.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.health_to_dam:
When enabled, JCraft attacks deal extra damage to
enemies with more than 20 max health, so
high-health mobs aren't disproportionately tanky.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.kill_vampiris:
When enabled, scoring a kill fully restores the
killer's hunger and heals them if they are a
vampire.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.mandom_affect:
When enabled, Mandom's time rewind also reverts
block changes, not just entities.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.meteor_spawn_:
Percent chance, per second, for a Stand Meteor to
fall near a player. Requires the fallingMeteors
gamerule and a suitable biome.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.mih_accelerat: Made in Heaven time accel duration
jcraft.serverconfig.option.mih_sprint_hu: Made in Heaven Sprint Hunger Multiplier
jcraft.serverconfig.option.mih_time_acce: Made in Heaven Time Accel Duration

How long Made in Heaven's time acceleration lasts,
in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
jcraft.serverconfig.option.mining_barrag:
When enabled, barrages break blocks while the user
is crouching, letting them mine with barrage
attacks.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.player_vamps_:
When enabled, vampire players take full Hamon
damage instead of being immune to it.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.reduce_deadly:
When enabled, the explosion power of beds, respawn
anchors, and end crystals is greatly reduced so
they aren't instantly lethal.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.roller_destro:
When enabled, the Road Roller destroys weak or
replaceable blocks it drives over.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.roller_flatte: When enabled, the Road Roller flattens blocks
jcraft.serverconfig.option.scaling_penal:
How much the combo damage multiplier drops with
each consecutive hit, down to the Damage Scaling
Minimum.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.show_all_cosp: Show all Cosplay in Creative Tab
jcraft.serverconfig.option.spawner_stand:
When disabled, mobs that come from monster
spawners will never spawn with a Stand.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.sptw_ignite_c: Star Platinum The World ignites Campfires
jcraft.serverconfig.option.sptw_time_sto: Star Platinum The World Timestop Duration

Maximum time Star Platinum: The World can stop
time, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
jcraft.serverconfig.option.stand_arrow_s:
Chance (0-1) that a mob spawning with a Stand also
holds a Stand Arrow, which it always drops on
death.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.stand_user_si:
When enabled, only players who have a Stand can
see Stands rendered in the world.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.stw_time_stop:
Maximum time Shadow The World can stop time, in
ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
When enabled, cooldown cancelling (CDC) is allowed
in Survival mode, letting players chain moves
faster.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.tw_time_stop_:
Maximum time The World can stop time, in ticks (20
ticks = 1 second).
jcraft.serverconfig.option.twoh_time_sto: The World Over Heaven Timestop Duration

Maximum time The World Over Heaven can stop time,
in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second).
jcraft.serverconfig.option.vs_standless_:
Multiplier applied to JCraft damage dealt to
entities that don't have a Stand.
jcraft.serverconfig.option.ws_steal_stan: Whitesnake can steal Stands from Players

When enabled, Whitesnake can steal Stands from
other players, not just non-player entities.
